body.text: I told my quartermasters it would, because you told me it would. I have had to go back and tell them otherwise, in front of the men, and I will not pretend that was a small thing.
I am not asking what happened. I am telling you that it happened, and that I know how to count.
I assume there is a reason. I should have liked to hear it from you first.

tone.text: On the money that did not come, I am {choice}.

options.text: sorrier than this letter can carry

steps.prompt: What is to be said to the Marshal

options.label: grant him a favour against the debt

options.label: offer nothing
options.text: There is nothing to be done about it this month.
